Overview.Name: Venkatesh G
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_2 (Dinner - light): Option 2: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Reduce salt intake to manage blood pressure.
Start meals with protein before eating rice.
Avoid sweets and processed foods as they affect both BP and fat loss.
Improve sleep duration as low sleep increases cravings and stress.
During social gatherings, eat your regular meal first to avoid overeating.
